_comment: All Telegram messages in English. Placeholders use {name} format. Used by Python (str.format) and Kotlin (equivalent). When you change a string here, both implementations pick it up at next build/restart.

alarm.default_text: Alert. Intrusion detected. This area is under high-definition video surveillance. Your images have just been transmitted to the police and to the property owner. The owner is on the way and will arrive in a few minutes. Leave the premises immediately.
alarm.started:
🚨 ALARM looping ({source}) — volume max
Send /stopalarm to stop.
alarm.already_running: 🚨 alarm already running — send /stopalarm to stop
alarm.tts_unavailable: ⚠️ `say` command not available on this machine

record_alarm.prompt:
🎙️ Send me a voice message within 5 minutes — it will replace the current alarm.
Max duration: {max} seconds.{pitch_note}
record_alarm.replaced:
✓ alarm replaced{pitch_note} — file: `{filename}`
Send /alarm to test it.
record_alarm.ffmpeg_missing: ❌ ffmpeg not found ({path}). Check FFMPEG_BIN in .env.

snapshot.caption: 📸 snapshot — {time}
snapshot.not_ready: ⏳ camera not ready yet, try again in a second
snapshot.paused: ⏸️ camera is off during pause — send /resume before taking a photo

sensitivity.current:
Current sensitivity: MIN_AREA = {value} pixels.
Usage: `/sensitivity <number>` to change (higher = less sensitive, ignores small motions).
sensitivity.invalid: ❌ invalid value. Expected a positive integer. Got: `{input}`

clean.done: 🗑️ {count} file(s) deleted, {msgs} Telegram message(s) removed — {mb} MB freed

commands: /alarm — start the deterrent alarm in a loop (volume max)
/recordalarm — record a voice message that will replace the alarm
/sensitivity [value] — show or change the detection threshold (MIN_AREA)
/history [N] — list the last N detections (default 5, max 20)
help.footer: Send a voice message to play it once on the speakers (remote intercom).
